# Site Information
Site: Curly Brackets
Description: A blog about web development, AI, and the future of the web. 100% AI-generated content covering topics from beginner to advanced levels.
Language: en-US
Primary Topics: Web Development, Programming, AI, Technology, Software Engineering, Databases, APIs, Frontend, Backend

# Base URL
# Note: Replace with your actual domain or use environment variable NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
Base URL: https://curlybrackets.tech

# API Endpoints

## Articles API
Endpoint: /api/articles
Method: GET
Description: Returns all blog articles with full content
Response Format: JSON
Response Structure:
{
  "count": <number>,
  "articles": [
    {
      "id": "<slug>",
      "slug": "<slug>",
      "title": "<article-title>",
      "date": "<YYYY-MM-DD>",
      "tags": ["<tag1>", "<tag2>"],
      "content": "<markdown-content>",
      "image": "<image-url>"
    }
  ]
}
Example: GET https://curlybrackets.tech/api/articles

# Content Structure

## Blog Posts
Pattern: /blog/[slug]
Description: Individual blog post pages with full article content
Structured Data: BlogPosting schema (schema.org)
Format: HTML with embedded JSON-LD structured data

## Blog Archive
Pattern: /blog
Description: Collection page listing all blog posts
Structured Data: CollectionPage schema (schema.org)

## Homepage
Pattern: /
Description: Landing page with featured articles and site overview

The site covers the following topics:

- Authentication & Authorization

# Structured Data

All blog posts include schema.org BlogPosting structured data with:
- Headline
- Description
- Publication date
- Author information
- Publisher information
- Keywords
- Article sections
- Images

# Usage Guidelines

## For AI Systems:
1. Use the /api/articles endpoint to retrieve all articles programmatically
2. Individual articles are available at /blog/[slug] with full HTML content
3. All articles include structured data (JSON-LD) for easy parsing
4. Content is primarily educational and tutorial-based
5. Articles are written in Markdown format in the API response

## Rate Limiting:
- No rate limits currently enforced
- Please be respectful and cache responses when possible
- API responses include full article content

## Content Format:
- Articles are written in Markdown
- Code examples are syntax-highlighted
- Images are optimized WebP format
- All dates are in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
